say:2:1013502001:2.text: Atalanta and I... we were friends once.
say:2:1013502001:2.source_cn: 我与阿塔兰忒，我们的确曾是朋友。我从小向往艾雅……

say:3:1013502002:2.text: When I was young, blessed by Dura's grace, I became the lead singer in the nearby Temple choir.
say:3:1013502002:2.source_cn: 蒙仁慈的艾雅恩赐，我得以成为了附近圣堂唱诗班的领唱。

say:4:1013502003:1.text: One day, as I sang in my stiff choir gown, I spotted a new face—a stray child.
say:4:1013502003:1.source_cn: 就在我穿着浆得硬硬的礼服裙唱歌的某一天，瞥见了一个生面...

say:5:1013502004:2.text: She was wandering around the Temple, and that same day there was a theft. Without proof, they just locked her up.
say:5:1013502004:2.source_cn: 她在圣堂中徘徊不去，恰逢当天发生窃案，神职者们未经取证...

choice_prompt:6:1013502004.text: She was wandering around the Temple, and that same day there was a theft. Without proof, they just locked her up.
choice_prompt:6:1013502004.source_cn: 她在圣堂中徘徊不去，恰逢当天发生窃案，神职者们未经取证，就直接把她关了起来。

say:7:1013502005:1.text: Yes. Hard to believe now, isn't it? Atalanta was actually pretty timid. They held her in a regular room, but she was terrified. She wouldn't even touch the food they brought her.
say:7:1013502005:1.source_cn: 嗯。现在看不出吧？阿塔其实很胆小的。关押她的地方只是个...

say:8:1013502006:1.text: Except when she saw me, she suddenly yelled, "Hey, get me out of this place! If it wasn't for your singing, I wouldn't be here!"
say:8:1013502006:1.source_cn: 唯独在看到我的时候，突然凶巴巴地大喊——“喂，快让我离...

say:9:1013502007:1.text: I felt really guilty. Listening to hymns isn't a crime. What happened to Atalanta was so unfair... That's when I aimed to become a knight.
say:9:1013502007:1.source_cn: 我内疚极了。期望聆听圣歌绝非罪孽，发生在阿塔身上的事很...

say:10:1013502008:1.text: I didn't want that kind of thing to happen again. Clearly, I haven't done well enough...
say:10:1013502008:1.source_cn: 我不想让这种事再次发生。艾雅在上，显然，我做得还不够好……

say:11:1013502009:1.text: You two must have been really close...
say:11:1013502009:1.source_cn: 你们一定曾是很要好的朋友吧……

say:12:1013502010:1.text: ...We meant the world to each other.
say:12:1013502010:1.source_cn: ……对彼此而言，我们都曾无可替代。
